highlights.title: Watch your bot's browser as it works
highlights.text: In a wide window, a bot's browser panel opens by itself while it browses and closes when it's done. A chip on the reply, like "Ben opened 2 pages", brings it back.

highlights.title: See every page a reply opened
highlights.text: "Pages this reply" lists the pages a bot opened, by title and newest first, with "Now" on the one it's on.

highlights.title: AI use over 7 or 30 days
highlights.text: Settings › All spaces › Usage shows your AI use for the last 7 or 30 days: the total, a bar for each day and each model's share.

highlights.title: Routines are easier to set up
highlights.text: Open Routines from the sidebar. "Weekdays" picks Monday to Friday in one tap, your time zone shows by name, like "Kyiv time", and each card says when it runs next.

highlights.title: Update checks no longer get stuck
highlights.text: Settings no longer stays on "Update checks are turned off here." It asks again on its own, and "Check again" asks right away.

fixes: Settings no longer gets stuck on "Update checks are turned off here": it asks again on its own and offers Check again.
A tool server can't take a name that differs from another one only in case, like Stripe next to stripe.
When kwant's Chrome closes right after starting, the message leads with the real error, not D-Bus noise.
